key_pathways: Direct renal and vascular smooth muscle effects

avoid_supplements.name: Licorice (Glycyrrhiza glabra)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Licorice potentiates vasopressin effects and increases sodium retention, significantly elevating hyponatremia and hypertension risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; monitor sodium levels if prior exposure

avoid_supplements.name: NSAIDs (ibuprofen, naproxen supplements)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: NSAIDs potentiate vasopressin antidiuretic effects and increase risk of water intoxication and hyponatremia
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid or use lowest effective dose with close sodium monitoring

caution_supplements.name: Sodium supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May complicate fluid and electrolyte management in patients receiving vasopressin therapy
caution_supplements.action: Monitor serum sodium levels regularly; coordinate supplementation with prescriber

caution_supplements.name: Tricyclic antidepressants (herbal or supplement forms)
caution_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate vasopressin antidiuretic effects through ADH sensitization
caution_supplements.action: Monitor fluid balance and sodium concentration

avoid_foods.name: High-sodium processed foods
avoid_foods.mechanism: Excess sodium intake may compound fluid retention and hypertension in vasopressin therapy, particularly in SIADH management
avoid_foods.action: Maintain sodium restriction as directed by clinical protocol; counsel on processed food avoidance

caution_foods.name: Excessive free water intake
caution_foods.mechanism: High fluid intake increases water intoxication risk in patients on vasopressin, especially in SIADH treatment
caution_foods.action: Implement fluid restriction per clinical guidelines; patient education on intake monitoring

caution_foods.name: Licorice-containing candies/foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Dietary licorice exposure may potentiate vasopressin effects and electrolyte imbalance
caution_foods.action: Educate patient to avoid licorice-flavored products

monitoring_notes: Monitor serum sodium, osmolality, and fluid status closely during vasopressin therapy due to potent effects on fluid and electrolyte balance. Watch for signs of water intoxication (confusion, seizures, cerebral edema) and adjust fluid/sodium intake accordingly.
